prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE original medieval RPG dialogue portrait, true transparent cutout, intended final 74 x 100 logical pixels.
Primary request: Substantively redraw ONDO (昂朵, YOS-NPC-ONDO), an ordinary cloth suitability inspector, in the rough restrained low-resolution dialogue-portrait language of the four core style references.

Input images: Image 1 is identity ONLY, the approved older full-body concept. Preserve mature male identity, short slightly untidy salt-brown hair with grey at temples, fine moustache and LIGHT chin stubble, muted olive shirt and ochre work-apron palette. Do NOT copy big cartoon eye whites, small nose, youthful face, full-body proportions, hands or tools. Images 2–5 are Mara/Iwo/Leiya/Tore: style/composition ONLY. Do not copy their identities, hair, clothing or heavy beard.

Current identity: MAN around FIFTY. Work-worn longish rectangular face, hooded narrow eyes that squint slightly to inspect material, slight asymmetry in brows, fine mouth compressed with calm concentration. Large angular nose, broad cheekbone/eye-socket shadow planes, understated crow's feet, deep but economical mouth-corner wear. Clearly middle-aged, neither young pretty-boy nor elderly patriarch. Existing short salt-brown hair, modest thin moustache, light isolated chin stubble; NOT Tore's heavy full beard. Current card specifies a tiny magnifier clip at neckline. Show it as a tiny dark brass clamp at one side of the muted olive collar, no dangling round glass and no eyeglasses. White inspection oversleeves lie outside this head-only crop, do not invent a white coat or scarf. Small hint of ochre apron strap at very bottom.

Composition, IMPORTANT: face-dominant head portrait at slight three-quarter toward viewer's left. Large face, strong nose and cheekbones, SMALL DARK tired eyes, almost no visible sclera (a single muted tan-grey speck per eye, NO pure white). Very SHORT neck and narrow compact olive collar. Minimal shoulders, no torso, apron body or hands. The complete silhouette must be contained WITH REAL EMPTY TRANSPARENT SPACE: entire crown, both sides of untidy hair, ears, chin, collar. Keep at least 5% canvas blank above crown, 5% blank on either side, 3% bottom blank. Hair and collar MUST NOT TOUCH ANY IMAGE BORDER. Build a narrow shoulder tip silhouette not canvas-width. Face occupies ~60% vertical span, collar only lowest 10%.

Style: intentionally coarse low-resolution pixel artwork for a 74x100 logical-pixel canvas, integer enlarged display. Connected angular clusters and stair-step contour, dark irregular outline, broad 3–8 logical-pixel skin planes, distinct angular nose wedge and cheekbone clusters, small eyes and small closed mouth. Rough restrained Stoneshard-like portrait vocabulary from the refs, not a clean doll-like cartoon. 24–32 muted visible colors approximately, warm skin and muted earth browns/olives/ochres. No smooth gradients, antialiasing, soft blur, tiny painterly texture or scattered 1-pixel noise, ornate rendering, glossy eye white, beauty symmetry, anime lashes, chibi. Transparent background (never black fill/checkerboard), one portrait only, no text/frame/watermark/props/scene. He checks only the actual authorized batch and is no medical doctor, quality overlord or seller.
